verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents a full Python API (iterm2 package) for scripting/controlling the app, plus AppleScript support, both with dedicated documentation pages and community corroboration of hands-on use (imgcat, it2dl, Python scripting praised as far superior to AppleScript). This constitutes a documented public API for programmatic/agentic control, though it's not a modern REST/OpenAPI-style API and no llms.txt/OpenAPI spec exists. Missing for 10: a formal OpenAPI/REST-style spec or llms.txt discoverability layer, and no evidence of AI-agent-specific SDK usage beyond scripting.
